verdict.rationale: The ADK GitHub README documents a Tool Confirmation flow (HITL) that guards tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input. It also lists human-in-the-loop as a supported feature of both the graph-based Workflow Runtime and the Task API, so pausing for human approval or input is a first-party capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the pause/resume mechanics (how state persists and how execution resumes with the human's decision), in-depth docs pages beyond README feature bullets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
